authorization.approved_resources: Agent-selected small local CPU-only language pilot within the approved experiment; no cloud, GPU, dependencies or paid resources. Does not resume any historical run.
authorization.user_approval_reference: Current chat: user said "ok do it" after the assistant proposed a fixed-step learned-sampling experiment with fixed curve, matching dense and upstream nanoGPT controls across multiple seeds.

dataset_versions.description: Public Shakespeare text from char-rnn Tiny Shakespeare. Snapshot included; content hash is authoritative despite mutable upstream URL.

data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: No Tiny Shakespeare references found in existing auto-research/src/data text search; no exhaustive audit of external chats/pretraining. Public familiar corpus, single work collection, no semantic deduplication; byte regions disjoint.

split_boundaries.sampling: Evaluation uses first N nonoverlapping 65-byte chunks of its split, 64 next-byte targets each. Train random 65-byte windows wholly inside train.

data.teacher_and_objective: No teacher; scratch next-byte CE over fixed 256-byte vocabulary; all positions scored.

decision.next_experiment: Determined only after this bounded pilot; no automatic retries or scale-up
decision.reason: No corpus training or confirmation evaluation before freeze

deployment.batching: Batch 1 isolated CPU subprocess per checkpoint
deployment.latency_statistics: p50 and nearest-rank p95 prefill and mean per-token decode across repetitions; throughput from median; startup excluded
deployment.memory_components: Parameter bytes; fresh process ru_maxrss including runtime, checkpoint load, data, activations/workspace. Before-model peak separately recorded. Current activation-only/allocator peaks unmeasured; no GPU.
deployment.prefill_decode_protocol: 64-byte selection prefill; greedy uncached decode 16 bytes from 32-byte prefix; same prompt, own generated continuations; each timed call computes all-position logits for consistency

compute_accounting.note: Projection-only analytic MACs omit attention, logits, coefficient/router work and backward; measured CPU and wall time reported. No FLOP-match claim.

design.control_rationale: Dense uses unchanged source GPT full with RoPE. nanoGPT is byte-exact pinned upstream 3adf61e154c3fe3fca428ad6bc3818b27a3b8291 with learned positions trained/evaluated at 64. Three curve arms have identical initial parameters, basis applications and block counts; fixed router is inert, global lacks token features. No curve reordering or halting.
design.matching_track: Same width, depth, data, exposure and optimizer recipe. Curve arms have equal stored parameters and basis computations; dense/nanoGPT have more independent weights but fewer basis matmuls. Not equal training FLOPs or latency.
design.mechanism_equations: W(t)=sum_k [P_k dot (1,t,t^2,t^3)] B_k. t0=0, t_last=1. Internal t_i=t_prev+(1-t_prev)*sigmoid(router([LN(h_token),t_prev])-log(L-i-1)). Router zero-output initialized. Global supplies zero token features. Fixed multiplies router output by zero. Same t for all six projections in each step; separate original per-block LayerNorm retained.
design.seed_selection_method: Prespecified reuse of the repository paired seed identifiers; new corpus and hypothesis

evaluation.duplicate_policy: Two complete evaluations per checkpoint; require exact CE and logit SHA256
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Fixed is single primary comparison. Global is required mechanistic control. Dense/nanoGPT comparisons diagnostic unless all gates pass; no selective winner reporting.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Final frozen checkpoints on reserved confirmation region, 16384 targets each
evaluation.uncertainty_method: All three paired gaps and descriptive paired t95 interval df=2; small n and normality unverified; common corpus is not independent datasets

evidence.preservation_policy: Exclusive creation; retain every checkpoint, seed, failure and original canary. No source/data/threshold modification after freeze.
evidence.protocol_sha256: Stored in SOURCE_MANIFEST and RUN_REGISTRY to avoid self-hash

execution.canary_matrix: CANARY.json; three shapes, nonconstant curves, forward/grad/AdamW parity, perturbed nonzero router causal logits/positions, ordered positions, nonzero and finite-difference router gradient

cost_estimate.additional: evaluation/benchmark/import overhead, within configured cap; no GPU estimates

execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Dedicated SSD git worktree and branch; original allocation branch and untracked RELEASE_ASSET_COPY.json preserved; no matching research workload observed. All child processes receive SSD TMPDIR; Python -B prevents bytecode writes.

experiment_id: Token-conditioned continuous-depth sampling at fixed steps
futility_rule: Stop on source/data drift, nonfinite loss/gradient, failed fidelity, resource or storage cap, or preservation failure. No early stopping or tuning from selection/confirmation; report all negative outcomes.
hypothesis: Token-conditioned ordered positions on the existing cubic weight curve reduce reserved byte CE relative to uniform sampling at identical block and basis counts.
primary_comparator: token versus fixed; global positions are the required explanatory control for token-specific benefit
primary_metric: Reserved confirmation mean next-byte CE, nats/byte
success_rule: All paired differences token-fixed < 0; mean <= -0.02 nats/byte; descriptive paired t95 upper < 0; all arms improve selection CE from initialization. Token-specific support additionally requires the same gate against global. NanoGPT claim additionally requires the same gates against dense and nanoGPT. Every row complete and duplicate-exact.

training.accessible_history: 64 bytes inside each reset window; no extrapolation endpoint
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: Final update only for every arm/seed; monitoring cannot select or retune
training.document_reset_policy: Independent windows; no additional document boundary metadata
